narrative:
## Handover Summary — Opex & Platform Cost

Opex envelopes and platform cost targets are locked.

## Key Decisions
• Legacy SMSC consolidation onto MyLINK CORE for international traffic
• Committed-use cloud discount on the engagement platform
• Single data platform for verification analytics

## Recommendation for GP & EBITDA Consolidation
Roll up all phases into the 21-market GP and adjusted EBITDA plan and prepare the Board & IR pack.

## Risk Factors
• Migration timing vs technology decision end-2026
• Dual-running cost during platform cut-over
